title: Offline Exhibition Demos
summary: Large-format interactive demos for industrial and aviation clients that run with zero network.
problem: Show floors have unreliable Wi-Fi, but the demo has to look perfect all day on large displays.
solution: Electron/Chromium apps combining CMS-sourced content with locally packaged media and 3D/WebGL visuals; investigated Windows GPU, Chromium and video-playback compatibility.
result: Self-contained builds that run on show-floor hardware without depending on the venue network.
